title: The Weinstein Jury Believed the Women

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导者，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 希望您能准时收看。

sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein is found guilty of two felony sex crimes, Jody Cantor and Megan Toohey, on what the jury was asked to do and what it means that they did it.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦被判犯有两项重罪性犯罪。乔迪·坎托和梅根·图伊将探讨陪审团被要求做什么，以及他们做出这一裁决意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月25日，星期二。

sentences.en: Jody and Megan, what did we understand about this case before it started?
sentences.zh: 乔迪和梅根，在案件开始前，我们对它有多少了解？

sentences.en: We knew the charges.
sentences.zh: 我们知道指控的内容。

sentences.en: We knew that Weinstein had been charged with criminal sexual assault of one woman.
sentences.zh: 我们知道温斯坦被控对一名女性实施了刑事性侵犯。

sentences.en: We knew that he had been charged with rape of another.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他被控强奸了另一名女性。

sentences.en: We knew that he had also been charged with predatory sexual assault, which is basically a pattern of predatory behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道他被控犯有掠夺性性侵罪，这基本上是一种掠夺性行为模式。

sentences.en: We also knew that it was complicated, that with at least one of the women in the charges,
sentences.zh: 我们也知道情况很复杂，因为在指控涉及的至少一名女性身上，

sentences.en: Weinstein appeared to have ongoing, friendly communication with her, that the defense was saying was proof that the entire relationship was consensual.
sentences.zh: 温斯坦似乎与她保持着持续、友好的沟通，辩方称这证明了整个关系是双方自愿的。

sentences.en: It seemed really narrow.
sentences.zh: 这看起来确实范围很窄。

sentences.en: Remember that there was an ocean of women who brought allegations against
sentences.zh: 请记住，有如海洋般众多的女性对

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein for sexual harassment, for sexual violence, and yet there were only two women at the center of these charges.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦提出了性骚扰和性暴力的指控，然而这些指控的核心却只有两名女性。

sentences.en: And remind us why that is, just two.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下为什么只有两位。

sentences.en: Well, some women had stories that lay beyond the statute of limitations, meaning their stories were essentially too old for them to participate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些女性的故事已经超出了诉讼时效，这意味着她们的故事基本上因为时间太久而无法参与诉讼。

sentences.en: Some of the behavior they described was not necessarily criminal.
sentences.zh: 她们描述的一些行为并不一定构成犯罪。

sentences.en: And also, there were some women who did not want to participate.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一些女性不想参与。

sentences.en: They were scared of the scrutiny of a criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 她们害怕刑事审判带来的审视。

sentences.en: And Jody, what didn't we know as the trial starts?
sentences.zh: 乔迪，在审判开始时，我们还有什么不知道的？

sentences.en: We didn't know a tremendous amount.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道的事情非常多。

sentences.en: Most importantly, we didn't know anything about the evidence.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们对证据一无所知。

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein's team had released these emails between him and some of his accusers.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦的团队公布了他与一些指控者之间的电子邮件。

sentences.en: Would they be able to actually prove that these relationships were affectionate, that they were romantic, that they were consensual?
sentences.zh: 他们能否真正证明这些关系是充满爱意的、浪漫的、并且是双方自愿的？

sentences.en: And therefore, quite possibly, not criminal.
sentences.zh: 因此，很可能不构成犯罪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Megan, what are you thinking as this trial is about to start?
sentences.zh: 那么，梅根，在审判即将开始时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: What's going through your head?
sentences.zh: 你脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'm very curious to know more of the details.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常好奇想知道更多的细节。

sentences.en: And if I'm being totally honest,
sentences.zh: 如果我完全诚实地说，

sentences.en: I'm also a little skeptical.
sentences.zh: 我也有一点怀疑。

sentences.en: The district attorney here in New York had come under
sentences.zh: 纽约的地区检察官在故事曝光后，

sentences.en: intense pressure to charge Weinstein once the story blew up.
sentences.zh: 承受了巨大的压力去起诉温斯坦。

sentences.en: There had been so much outrage that the district attorney's office had failed to bring charges against Harvey Weinstein in 2015 when a
sentences.zh: 当时有太多的愤怒指向地区检察官办公室，因为他们在2015年未能对哈维·温斯坦提起诉讼，当时一名

sentences.en: woman actually went to the police to report being groped by him that the DA's office was now under so
sentences.zh: 女性确实去警察局报案称遭到他的猥亵。现在地区检察官办公室承受了

sentences.en: much pressure that they would maybe bring charges now before they had a really solid case in hand.
sentences.zh: 如此大的压力，以至于他们可能在还没有掌握真正扎实的证据之前就提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: That basically, they were responding to public outcry, not necessarily the strongest possible legal case.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们是在回应公众的强烈抗议，而不是基于最强有力的法律依据。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So what happens, Jodi, when the trial actually begins?
sentences.zh: 那么乔迪，当审判真正开始时发生了什么？

sentences.en: It feels really momentous.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常重大。

sentences.en: We're down at 100 Center Street in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 我们在曼哈顿中央街100号。

sentences.en: There are a million cameras.
sentences.zh: 有数百万台摄像机。

sentences.en: It's almost like him showing up on a kind of red carpet in reverse.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像他走在一种反向的红地毯上。

sentences.en: He's got this walker that immediately becomes the cause of a lot of suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他拿着那个助行器，立刻引起了许多怀疑。

sentences.en: He kind of hobbles into court.
sentences.zh: 他一瘸一拐地走进法庭。

sentences.en: Mr. Weinstein, how are you feeling today?
sentences.zh: 温斯坦先生，你今天感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: How's your back?
sentences.zh: 你的背怎么样？

sentences.en: Not so good.
sentences.zh: 不太好。

sentences.en: Better.
sentences.zh: 好些了。

sentences.en: And the prosecution and the defense make their openings, and then the prosecution begins to call witnesses.
sentences.zh: 控辩双方进行了开庭陈述，然后检方开始传唤证人。

sentences.en: And what you immediately see is, you know, there's a saying in sex crimes prosecution that there are no perfect victiMs. And what people mean by that is that these stories
sentences.zh: 你立刻会发现，你知道，性犯罪起诉中有一句谚语，即没有完美的受害者。人们的意思是，这些故事

sentences.en: don't unfold in neat scripts.
sentences.zh: 并不是按照整齐的剧本展开的。

sentences.en: Almost every sex crime story has its sort of wrinkles, its counterintuitive elements.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个性犯罪故事都有其复杂之处，有其反直觉的元素。

sentences.en: But we see that in particular, this case is not a case with quote-unquote perfect victiMs. There are six alleged Weinstein victims who testify during this trial.
sentences.zh: 但我们特别看到，这个案件并不是一个所谓的“完美受害者”案件。在这次审判中，有六名据称是温斯坦的受害者出庭作证。

sentences.en: On the one hand, there's Jessica Mann and Miriam Haley.
sentences.zh: 一方面，有杰西卡·曼和米里亚姆·哈利。

sentences.en: They are the basis of the charges.
sentences.zh: 她们是这些指控的基础。

sentences.en: The jury is making its decisions based on whether they believe these women's stories or not.
sentences.zh: 陪审团的决定取决于他们是否相信这些女性的故事。

sentences.en: On the other far end, there are these kind of pattern witnesses, these
sentences.zh: 在另一个极端，有这些所谓的模式证人，这些

sentences.en: Molyneux witnesses.
sentences.zh: 莫利纽克斯证人。

sentences.en: It's a controversial concept in the law.
sentences.zh: 这是法律中一个有争议的概念。

sentences.en: There's been a big fight over whether they should even be included that the prosecution won.
sentences.zh: 关于是否应该将她们纳入证人名单，曾有过一场激烈的争论，最终检方获胜。

sentences.en: They're there simply to establish a pattern.
sentences.zh: 她们出庭仅仅是为了确立一种模式。

sentences.en: It's like in the Cosby trial when you had additional witnesses, you know, repeating the same details, telling the same stories of predation.
sentences.zh: 就像在科斯比案中，你有额外的证人，你知道，重复同样的细节，讲述同样的掠夺故事。

sentences.en: It's very powerful.
sentences.zh: 这非常有说服力。

sentences.en: But the jury can't actually decide anything based on what they say.
sentences.zh: 但陪审团实际上不能根据她们所说的话做出任何裁决。

sentences.en: They're not at the basis of the charges.
sentences.zh: 她们不是指控的基础。

sentences.en: And in the middle is Annabella Sciorra, and she's playing a very unusual role in this trial.
sentences.zh: 而在中间的是安娜贝拉·莎拉，她在这次审判中扮演了一个非常不寻常的角色。

sentences.en: She tells this story of being violently raped by Harvey Weinstein many years ago.
sentences.zh: 她讲述了多年前被哈维·温斯坦暴力强奸的故事。

sentences.en: It's emotional testimony.
sentences.zh: 这是充满情感的证词。

sentences.en: There's major news coverage.
sentences.zh: 有重大的新闻报道。

sentences.en: But she doesn't remember everything about it.
sentences.zh: 但她并不记得关于这件事的一切。

sentences.en: It's a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 那是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: And remember, the Annabella Sciorra case is outside the statute of limitations.
sentences.zh: 请记住，安娜贝拉·莎拉的案件已经超出了诉讼时效。

sentences.en: So the jury cannot convict or quit Harvey Weinstein simply based on Annabella Sciorra's story.
sentences.zh: 所以陪审团不能仅仅根据安娜贝拉·莎拉的故事来判定哈维·温斯坦有罪或无罪。

sentences.en: But if they believe those first two women, either Jessica Mann or Miriam Haley or both, and
sentences.zh: 但如果他们相信前两名女性，即杰西卡·曼或米里亚姆·哈利中的任何一位或两位，

sentences.en: then if they also believe Annabella Sciorra and add her, then they can get to the most serious charges
sentences.zh: 然后如果他们也相信安娜贝拉·莎拉并加上她的证词，那么他们就可以达到最严重的指控，

sentences.en: of predatory sexual assault, which can potentially send Harvey Weinstein to prison for life.
sentences.zh: 即掠夺性性侵罪，这有可能将哈维·温斯坦送进监狱终身监禁。

sentences.en: So Megan, after this dramatic testimony from Annabella Sciorra, what happens in the trial?
sentences.zh: 那么梅根，在安娜贝拉·莎拉发表了这番戏剧性的证词后，审判中发生了什么？

sentences.en: Both Miriam Haley and Jessica Mann testify.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆·哈利和杰西卡·曼都出庭作证了。

sentences.en: The two women at the center of the criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 这两位处于刑事指控核心的女性。

sentences.en: The two women at the center of the criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 这两位处于刑事指控核心的女性。

sentences.en: And in both cases, their stories turn out to be more complicated than we could have ever predicted.
sentences.zh: 在这两个案例中，她们的故事都比我们预想的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: In the case of Miriam Haley, she talks about how when she first met Weinstein, she was trying to get breaks in the entertainment industry.
sentences.zh: 以米里亚姆·哈利为例，她谈到当她第一次见到温斯坦时，她正试图在娱乐业寻找机会。

sentences.en: And he helped her get a job as a production assistant on one of his TV shows.
sentences.zh: 他帮助她在他的一部电视节目中获得了一份制片助理的工作。

sentences.en: And that it had started what was kind of half personal, half professional relationship.
sentences.zh: 那段关系开始时既有私人成分，也有职业成分。

sentences.en: She says that he assaulted her, that he sexually assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 她说他侵犯了她，他性侵犯了她。

sentences.en: But that after that, she continued to have friendly communication with him.
sentences.zh: 但在此之后，她继续与他保持友好的沟通。

sentences.en: And two weeks after that, she agreed to meet him at a hotel room where she says she had sex with him without resisting.
sentences.zh: 两周后，她同意在一家酒店房间见他，她说她在没有反抗的情况下与他发生了性关系。

sentences.en: And so that is looking to be more nuanced than we originally knew.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来比我们最初了解的要微妙得多。

sentences.en: And by nuance, you mean it introduces the possibility of some kind of consent.
sentences.zh: 你所说的“微妙”，是指它引入了某种形式的“同意”的可能性。

sentences.en: A question.
sentences.zh: 一个疑问。

sentences.en: It certainly is providing the defense with an opportunity to do some serious cross-examination of her.
sentences.zh: 这无疑为辩方提供了一个对她进行严厉盘问的机会。

sentences.en: It wasn't just that she had returned to meet with him in private and had actually had sex with him after her alleged sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是她在所谓的性侵犯后又回去私下见他并确实与他发生了性关系。

sentences.en: It's that she continued to send him messages and signed one of her emails, love Mimi.
sentences.zh: 而是她继续给他发信息，并在其中一封电子邮件中署名“爱你的咪咪”。

sentences.en: And so the defense and its cross-examination is going really hard at her on that and suggesting that this is evidence that the whole relationship was consensual and that she
sentences.zh: 因此，辩方在盘问中对此紧追不舍，暗示这是整个关系是自愿的证据，并且她

sentences.en: was actually using him to try to advance her career.
sentences.zh: 实际上是在利用他来试图提升自己的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And how does she explain the ongoing relationship she has with Weinstein after this encounter?
sentences.zh: 那么她如何解释在这次遭遇后她与温斯坦持续的关系？

sentences.en: Well, she describes it as she was kind of trying to regain some sort of power, that she was trying to reframe and regain control over what had happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她将其描述为她试图重新获得某种力量，她试图重构并重新控制所发生的一切。

sentences.en: And then she says in terms of staying in touch with him after the fact and having friendly communication with him after the fact,
sentences.zh: 然后她说，关于事后与他保持联系并与他进行友好沟通，

sentences.en: that that was because she was just trying to maintain a positive professional relationship to help her with her career.
sentences.zh: 那是因为她只是试图维持一种积极的职业关系，以帮助她的事业。

sentences.en: And she even at one point had used the language of, I was just trying to put it away in a box and pretend like it didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在某个时候用了这样的语言：“我只是试图把它关进盒子里，假装它没有发生过。”

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And what about Jessica Mann?
sentences.zh: 那杰西卡·曼呢？

sentences.en: If Miriam Haley looks like a little more complicated on the witness stand, Jessica Mann looks so much more complex.
sentences.zh: 如果说米里亚姆·哈利在证人席上看起来稍微复杂一点，那么杰西卡·曼看起来要复杂得多。

sentences.en: This is a woman who didn't just have some friendly communication with him after she says she was sexually assaulted by him.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在她说自己被他性侵后，不仅与他有过友好沟通的女性。

sentences.en: She describes a three-year romantic relationship with him that went in and out of consensual and non-consensual sex.
sentences.zh: 她描述了一段与他长达三年的恋爱关系，这段关系在自愿和非自愿性行为之间反复。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And that she felt like he was powerful and that he manipulated her and that she stayed within his
sentences.zh: 她说她觉得他很有权势，他操纵了她，她留在了他的

sentences.en: web of control because she didn't know how to break out of it and that she feared that he could actually even harm her family if she didn't participate.
sentences.zh: 控制网中，因为她不知道如何摆脱，而且她担心如果她不配合，他甚至可能伤害她的家人。

sentences.en: And in this case, the cross-examination is pretty brutal at times.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，盘问有时相当残酷。

sentences.en: In fact, Jessica Mann, in trying to explain how and why she stayed in this relationship with
sentences.zh: 事实上，杰西卡·曼在试图解释她为什么在被他（正如她所说）侵犯多年后仍与

sentences.en: Weinstein for years after he had, you know, as she's told it, assaulted her, she is getting increasingly upset.
sentences.zh: 温斯坦保持这种关系时，变得越来越不安。

sentences.en: And there is one point where she just breaks down sobbing uncontrollably and the
sentences.zh: 有一次她甚至崩溃得无法控制地啜泣，

sentences.en: judge has to adjourn court early for the day because it looks like she's pretty much almost having a panic attack.
sentences.zh: 法官不得不提前休庭，因为看起来她几乎要惊恐发作了。

sentences.en: And she can even be heard after court has adjourned behind a closed door screaming.
sentences.zh: 在休庭后，甚至还能听到她在关上的门后尖叫。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So Jodi and I are watching this and thinking, wow, this looks really painful and it seems somewhat unusual that prosecutors would bring charges in these cases.
sentences.zh: 所以乔迪和我在观察这一切，心想，哇，这看起来真的很痛苦，而且检察官在这些案件中提起诉讼似乎有些不同寻常。

sentences.en: And then we actually start working the phones.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始四处打听。

sentences.en: We start calling around to former prosecutors and defense attorneys and they're saying it is unusual.
sentences.zh: 我们开始打电话给前检察官和辩护律师，他们都说这确实不寻常。

sentences.en: While sex crimes experts will tell you that it's not unusual for victims to have ongoing communication with their perpetrators, that it's not unusual for them to even have sex with
sentences.zh: 虽然性犯罪专家会告诉你，受害者与施害者保持持续沟通并不罕见，甚至在事后与

sentences.en: them after the fact, that it's really unusual.
sentences.zh: 他们发生性关系也不罕见，但这确实非常不寻常。

sentences.en: It basically never happens that prosecutors bring charges in these type of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 检察官在这些情况下提起诉讼基本上从未发生过。

sentences.en: And so we are also, as we're doing this reporting, realizing that, in fact, this prosecution appears to be even more risky than we had originally thought.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在进行报道时也意识到，事实上，这次起诉似乎比我们最初想象的还要冒险。

sentences.en: And what some of these observers are so worried about as they're watching the trial, these are
sentences.zh: 而一些观察家在观看审判时非常担心，这些人是

sentences.en: prosecutors, former prosecutors, they're saying, is the prosecution meeting the bar for explaining these relationships?
sentences.zh: 检察官、前检察官，他们说，检方是否达到了解释这些关系的门槛？

sentences.en: When you have these kind of complexities in a trial, you have to really own them.
sentences.zh: 当审判中出现这种复杂情况时，你必须真正掌控它们。

sentences.en: You have to acknowledge that this is very complicated and you have to provide a narrative of how, essentially, how a relationship can become so abusive.
sentences.zh: 你必须承认这是非常复杂的，你必须提供一个叙述，说明一段关系本质上是如何变得如此虐待的。

sentences.en: And the prosecution is working on it.
sentences.zh: 检方正在努力解决这个问题。

sentences.en: They call this sex crimes expert, Dr. Barbara Ziv, who's counseled many, many victiMs. And she's
sentences.zh: 他们传唤了性犯罪专家芭芭拉·齐夫博士，她曾为许多受害者提供咨询。她

sentences.en: talking about how there's often this kind of counterintuitive behavior and how these relationships can be extremely abusive.
sentences.zh: 谈到了这种反直觉的行为往往是如何发生的，以及这些关系如何可能极具虐待性。

sentences.en: And why are these outside prosecutors worried about a case that's not their own?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些外部检察官会担心一个不属于他们的案件？

sentences.en: Because they realize the symbolic importance of what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 因为他们意识到这里所发生事情的象征意义。

sentences.en: And remember that in prosecution generally, there's this big philosophical question of, do you try the easier, more clear-cut cases where you're more assured of victory?
sentences.zh: 请记住，在起诉中，通常存在一个重大的哲学问题：你是去审理那些更容易、更清晰、更有把握获胜的案件吗？

sentences.en: Or do you take the really risky cases, which on the one hand can be a source of progress, but on the other hand, they can be a source of a kind of backlash?
sentences.zh: 还是去处理那些真正冒险的案件？这些案件一方面可能是进步的源泉，但另一方面，它们也可能成为某种反弹的源泉。

sentences.en: You know, what these sources are worried about is, what if the prosecution against Harvey Weinstein fails?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些消息来源担心的是，如果对哈维·温斯坦的起诉失败了会怎样？

sentences.en: And in doing so, give support to the idea that Me Too has gone too far, that Me Too is exaggerated, that victim stories aren't completely credible.
sentences.zh: 这样做，实际上是在支持一种观点，即“我也是”（Me Too）运动已经走得太远了，它被夸大了，受害者的故事并不完全可信。

sentences.en: In other words, all these prosecutors and these sex crimes experts you're talking to, they recognize these women's descriptions.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你所交谈的所有这些检察官和性犯罪专家，他们都认可这些女性的描述。

sentences.en: They understand these complicated relationships.
sentences.zh: 他们理解这些复杂的关系。

sentences.en: They don't doubt them.
sentences.zh: 他们并不怀疑这些女性。

sentences.en: But they think that by putting these on trial, it could actually undermine the work that they're doing and future cases like this.
sentences.zh: 但他们认为，将这些案件诉诸法庭，实际上可能会破坏他们正在进行的工作，以及未来类似的案件。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: They're saying, is the Harvey Weinstein trial, of all things, actually going to end up swinging the pendulum back in the other direction away from victims?
sentences.zh: 他们想问的是，哈维·温斯坦（Harvey Weinstein）的审判，在所有事情中，最终会不会导致舆论天平向反方向倾斜，从而背离受害者？

sentences.en: And that's actually what Harvey Weinstein's defense team is arguing in the court.
sentences.zh: 而这正是哈维·温斯坦的辩护团队在法庭上所主张的。

sentences.en: They are saying that this entire case is proof that the Me Too movement has gone too far, that all of these women had
sentences.zh: 他们声称整个案件证明了“我也是”运动已经走得太远了，所有这些女性都

sentences.en: consented to these sexual encounters with Weinstein, and that they are now being relabeled and reimagined.
sentences.zh: 同意与温斯坦发生性关系，而现在她们的经历被重新贴上了标签，被重新解读了。

sentences.en: They caution about basically accepting a universe where women have no agency and are not held responsible for
sentences.zh: 他们告诫人们，不要轻易接受一个女性没有自主权、不对自己的行为负责的世界，

sentences.en: their actions, for agreeing to go to hotel rooms to meet men and not expecting there to be sexual advances.
sentences.zh: 比如同意去酒店房间见男人，却不预料到会有性挑逗。

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein's lead defense attorney is this woman, Donna Rattuno, who has made a career of
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦的首席辩护律师是这位女士，唐娜·拉图诺（Donna Rotunno），她的职业生涯一直致力于

sentences.en: representing men accused of sexual misconduct and is basically becoming the female face of the
sentences.zh: 为被控性行为不端的男性辩护，她基本上已经成为了“我也是”运动

sentences.en: backlash to Me Too, and really seeking to frame the defense within that backlash at every turn.
sentences.zh: 反弹的女性代言人，并且在每一个转折点都试图将辩护框架置于这种反弹之中。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Megan, what are you thinking about as you consider the jury in this case and them taking this all in?
sentences.zh: 梅根（Megan），当你考虑到本案的陪审团以及他们对这一切的吸收时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: So I'm looking at these 12 jurors, these seven men and five women, and thinking, wow,
sentences.zh: 我在看着这12名陪审员，这7名男性和5名女性，心想，哇，

sentences.en: we as a country have not been able to come to a consensus on some of the most basic questions of the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: 作为一个国家，我们还没能就“我也是”运动中一些最基本的问题达成共识。

sentences.en: And here they are being asked to go off and decide and render a verdict on some of the most thorny issues that we're all grappling with right now when it comes to sex and power and
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们被要求去裁决和做出判决，处理我们所有人目前在性、权力和

sentences.en: consent.
sentences.zh: 同意方面正在纠结的一些最棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And this isn't just a case in which the two central accusers acknowledge having consensual sex with Weinstein after they say he victimized them.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个两位核心指控者承认在她们所说的受害后与温斯坦发生过自愿性行为的案件。

sentences.en: This is also a case that's missing a lot of the key things that you find in sex crimes prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个缺失了许多性犯罪起诉中常见关键证据的案件。

sentences.en: You're not finding a lot of corroborating witnesses and other evidence to bolster the case.
sentences.zh: 你找不到多少佐证证人或其他证据来支持这个案件。

sentences.en: It really feels like it's coming down to
sentences.zh: 感觉真的归结为

sentences.en: do you believe these women?
sentences.zh: 你相信这些女性吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's basically the pitch that the prosecution makes to these 12 jurors.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是检方对这12名陪审员所做的陈述。

sentences.en: And on the very final day of arguments, what the prosecution is doing is they're arguing the case on the facts they have,
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词的最后一天，检方所做的是，他们基于现有的事实进行辩论，

sentences.en: but they're also making a kind of plea for a different world, a different, more nuanced, more humane way of looking at rape victiMs. They're saying, look, sometimes their behavior
sentences.zh: 但他们也在为另一个世界发出呼吁，一种看待强奸受害者时更不同、更细致、更人道的方式。他们说，看，有时她们的行为

sentences.en: is contradictory.
sentences.zh: 是矛盾的。

sentences.en: Sometimes they're slow to even acknowledge and accept that a crime has occurred.
sentences.zh: 有时她们甚至迟迟不愿承认和接受犯罪已经发生的事实。

sentences.en: But that's what we need to start understanding.
sentences.zh: 但这正是我们需要开始理解的地方。

sentences.en: Joe Naluzzi, the prosecutor, says, come enter this new world.
sentences.zh: 检察官乔·纳卢齐（Joe Naluzzi）说，来进入这个新世界吧。

sentences.en: Come enter this new and more nuanced understanding of who rape victims are and how they behave.
sentences.zh: 来进入这种对强奸受害者是谁以及她们如何表现的更深刻、更细致的理解吧。

sentences.en: So then the following Tuesday, the judge basically says to the jury, you go decide.
sentences.zh: 于是接下来的周二，法官基本上对陪审团说，你们去决定吧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Jodi, Megan, tell us about today, Monday.
sentences.zh: 那么乔迪（Jodi）、梅根，告诉我们今天，也就是周一的情况。

sentences.en: Well, the jury's been deliberating for four days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，陪审团已经审议了四天。

sentences.en: And actually, at the very end of the day on Friday, there was kind of an inkling that a verdict was coming.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在周五快结束的时候，有一种预感，判决即将出炉。

sentences.en: And the courtroom, I think from the first moment this morning, based on what we heard, felt kind of momentous.
sentences.zh: 我想从今天早上第一刻起，根据我们听到的情况，法庭就有一种庄重感。

sentences.en: And then soon enough, midway through the morning, they come out and they say a verdict has been reached.
sentences.zh: 很快，在上午中段，他们出来宣布已经达成判决。

sentences.en: And when the verdict is read out, it is mixed.
sentences.zh: 当判决被宣读出来时，结果是喜忧参半的。

sentences.en: The jury has found Weinstein not guilty of those predatory sexual assault charges, the ones that could have potentially sent him to prison for the rest of his life.
sentences.zh: 陪审团裁定温斯坦那些掠夺性性侵犯罪名不成立，那些原本可能让他余生都在监狱中度过的指控。

sentences.en: But they have found him guilty of criminal sexual assault of Miriam Haley and of third-degree rape of Jessica Mann.
sentences.zh: 但他们裁定他犯有对米里亚姆·哈利（Miriam Haley）的刑事性侵罪，以及对杰西卡·曼（Jessica Mann）的三级强奸罪。

sentences.en: So this jury believed both of these women, despite all the complexities and all the nuance and all the layers of their cases.
sentences.zh: 所以这个陪审团相信了这两位女性，尽管她们案件中存在所有的复杂性、细微差别和层层疑点。

sentences.en: That's what the verdict suggests, that they did in fact believe them.
sentences.zh: 这就是判决所暗示的，他们确实相信了她们。

sentences.en: What is Harvey Weinstein's reaction to this verdict?
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦对这个判决有什么反应？

sentences.en: So Harvey Weinstein is apparently sitting there motionless, and he eventually turns to his defense attorneys and says over and over again, but I'm innocent, but I'm innocent.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦显然坐在那里一动不动，他最终转向他的辩护律师，一遍又一遍地说，但我无罪，但我无罪。

sentences.en: So there's a sense of disbelief.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种难以置信的感觉。

sentences.en: It sounds like he was in total disbelief.
sentences.zh: 听起来他完全无法相信。

sentences.en: And not long after court is finally adjourned,
sentences.zh: 法庭最终休庭后不久，

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Cy Vance, the district attorney, the head prosecutor overseeing this case, holds a press conference.
sentences.zh: 负责监督此案的地区检察官、首席检察官赛·万斯（Cy Vance）举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Rape is rape whether the survivor reports within an hour, within a year, or perhaps never.
sentences.zh: 强奸就是强奸，无论幸存者是在一小时内、一年内，还是可能永远不报告。

sentences.en: It's rape despite the complicated dynamics of power and consent after an assault.
sentences.zh: 尽管在袭击发生后存在复杂的权力和同意动态，它依然是强奸。

sentences.en: It's rape, even if there is no physical evidence, and even if it happened a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 即使没有物证，即使事情发生在很久以前，它依然是强奸。

sentences.en: This is the new landscape for survivors of sexual assault in America, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信，这就是美国性侵幸存者面临的新局面。

sentences.en: And this is a new day.
sentences.zh: 这是新的一天。

sentences.en: Megan, what do you make of what Cy Vance is saying?
sentences.zh: 梅根，你如何看待赛·万斯所说的话？

sentences.en: I mean, Cy Vance is trying to paint this conviction with the most sweeping strokes possible, saying that this is ushering in a whole new era of sex crimes prosecutions
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，赛·万斯正试图以尽可能宏大的笔触来描绘这次定罪，称这开启了性犯罪起诉的一个全新时代，

sentences.en: and delivering an unprecedented level of accountability and justice for victims of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 并为性侵受害者带来了前所未有的问责和正义。

sentences.en: Is he right?
sentences.zh: 他是对的吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's the question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这才是问题所在。

sentences.en: So for two years now, Megan and I have been looking at the impact of Me Too, and we see that social attitudes have changed.
sentences.zh: 两年来，我和梅根一直在观察“我也是”运动的影响，我们看到社会态度已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: But we've said to ourselves, when does that actually begin to come into the courtroom?
sentences.zh: 但我们一直在问自己，这什么时候才能真正进入法庭？

sentences.en: When does it change a jury's perception?
sentences.zh: 它什么时候能改变陪审团的看法？

sentences.en: When does it change a judge's perception?
sentences.zh: 它什么时候能改变法官的看法？

sentences.en: Look, it's too hard to say yet.
sentences.zh: 看，现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: But I do think there's something that may be very true here.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为这里可能有一些非常真实的东西。

sentences.en: Not really the way Cy Vance put it, but it may turn out to be correct that in bringing this very risky, very high profile, very boundary pushing case, the Manhattan DA actually has
sentences.zh: 并不是赛·万斯所说的那样，但结果可能是正确的，即通过提起这个风险极高、备受瞩目、极具突破性的案件，曼哈顿地区检察官实际上

sentences.en: expanded what feels possible in sex crimes prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 扩大了性犯罪起诉中可能实现的范围。

sentences.en: And that it does reshape the public understanding and belief about which victims deserve their day in court.
sentences.zh: 它确实重塑了公众对哪些受害者应该在法庭上获得公正对待的理解和信念。

sentences.en: And that, of course, is a real victory for some people and a very scary overreach for others, I imagine.
sentences.zh: 当然，我想这对一些人来说是真正的胜利，而对另一些人来说则是非常可怕的越权。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are definitely other people who have watched and seen prosecutors not just bring this case, but win it.
sentences.zh: 肯定还有其他人一直在观察，看到检察官不仅提起了这个案件，还赢了它。

sentences.en: And to see these jurors convict on something that the rest of society had yet to come to consensus on and have said that this whole thing has gone too far.
sentences.zh: 看到这些陪审员对社会其他部分尚未达成共识的事情做出定罪，而社会上有人说这一切已经走得太远了。

sentences.en: Jodi, Megan, thank you very, very much.
sentences.zh: 乔迪、梅根，非常非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, lawyers for Harvey Weinstein said they would appeal his conviction,
sentences.zh: 周一下午，哈维·温斯坦的律师表示他们将对他的定罪提出上诉，

sentences.en: as well as the judge's decision to hold him in jail until his sentencing, scheduled for March 11th.
sentences.zh: 以及法官决定将他关押至3月11日宣判日的决定。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: Ugly day for Wall Street, the worst we've seen for stocks in years.
sentences.zh: 华尔街度过了糟糕的一天，这是我们多年来见过的股市最糟糕的表现。

sentences.en: Take a look at how he finished up the day.
sentences.zh: 看看他这一天是如何收盘的。

sentences.en: Fear of economic fallout from the coronavirus reached the financial markets on Monday.
sentences.zh: 对冠状病毒经济影响的担忧在周一波及了金融市场。

sentences.en: What this has to do with is the spread of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这与冠状病毒的传播有关。

sentences.en: Now, we've known for quite some time that the Chinese cases have been escalating.
sentences.zh: 我们很早就知道中国的病例一直在增加。

sentences.en: As the stock market plunged over the prospect that the disease will hurt global commerce.
sentences.zh: 随着股市因该疾病将损害全球商业的前景而暴跌。

sentences.en: But now it seems so investors have turned their attention to what's happening overall with cases outside of China.
sentences.zh: 但现在看来，投资者已经将注意力转向了中国以外病例的整体情况。

sentences.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by more than 1,000 points, or 3.5 percent.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数下跌了超过1000点，即3.5%。

sentences.en: And European markets experienced their worst day in four years.
sentences.zh: 欧洲市场经历了四年来最糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: That fall-off came as Europe experienced its first major outbreak of the virus, with 229 confirmed cases in Italy,
sentences.zh: 这种下跌是因为欧洲经历了第一次大规模的病毒爆发，意大利有229例确诊病例，

sentences.en: where officials have now locked down 11 towns in the country's north.
sentences.zh: 当地官员现已封锁了该国北部的11个城镇。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》（Metro）的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失去控制的故事。
